title: Async Rust
summary: An overview of asynchronous Rust - why async exists, futures and async fn, .await, why a runtime such as Tokio is needed, spawning tasks, running futures concurrently with join and select, async I/O, channels and timeouts, Send and 'static bounds on tasks, and choosing between threads and async.

cards.q: What does calling an async fn return?
cards.a: A future, which does nothing until it is awaited or spawned on a runtime.

cards.q: Why is calling std::thread::sleep inside an async task a problem?
cards.a: It blocks the runtime's thread, stopping every other task scheduled on it; use the async sleep instead.
